name: Lemure

actions.name: Dogpile
actions.effect: If at least 2 other Lemures are adjacent to the target, the target is grappled.

reactions.name: Regenerate
reactions.effect: At the end of any turn, the Lemure regains 3 HP. Does not function if it took radiant or fire damage that turn.

traits.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
traits.desc: A destroyed Lemure reforms in the Nine Hells after 1d10 days unless killed by radiant damage or a blessed weapon.

traits.name: Mindless
traits.desc: Immune to charm and fear effects. Cannot be reasoned with.

lore: Lemures are the lowest form of devil, shapeless blobs of molten flesh that were once mortal souls condemned to the Nine Hells. They are mindless, expendable, and endlessly reforming, used as fodder by greater devils.
